The two are ~0.7% apart and are NOT two measurements of one container quantity — they are two distinct spectral-channel readouts of the substrate (a₀-region spectral-action vs a₂-Seeley-DeWitt growth). PASS is artifact-existence (`get_constant` resolves both pins with non-empty channel-distinct PROVENANCE + the cross-note), NOT a numerical threshold.

# (7) substitution_chain — the ~0.7% inter-channel spread is a magnitude/comparison
#     claim that enters the cross-note; the chain is pre-registered here so the
#     cross-note value is not discovered at runtime (per math-scripts.md
#     §"Double-Check Logic Before Compute").
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "sigma8_OZ_50 and sigma8_growth_a2 are ~0.7% apart; O-Z is the larger."
    Definition 1: sigma8_OZ_50      = 0.799     [SIGMA8-OZ-50, S50 PASS; atlas-07 PERMANENT]
    Definition 2: sigma8_growth_a2  = 0.79317   [s59_growth_factor.npz=0.793166→0.79317 5-sig; S97-FSIGMA8-FORECAST-REFETCH PASS audit a20043e7]
    Definition 3: rel_spread := |sigma8_OZ_50 − sigma8_growth_a2| / sigma8_growth_a2   [relative difference, growth-channel denominator]
    Substitute:   rel_spread = |0.799 − 0.79317| / 0.79317
    Simplify:     = 0.00583 / 0.79317
                  = 0.007350...  (= 0.735%)
    Canonical form: rel_spread = 0.735%  (≈ 0.7%)
    Direction:    0.799 > 0.79317  ⇒  sigma8_OZ_50 (O-Z channel) is LARGER than sigma8_growth_a2 (growth channel) by 0.735%.
    Cross-check (vs LCDM, both channels SMALLER than the Planck-2018 reference sigma_8=0.811):
        O-Z vs LCDM:    (0.799   − 0.811)/0.811 = −0.01480  = −1.48% ≈ -1.50% (matches SIGMA8-OZ-50 published -1.50%)
        growth vs LCDM: (0.79317 − 0.811)/0.811 = −0.02198  = −2.20% ≈ -2.18%
    Conclusion:   the cross-note records rel_spread ≈ 0.7% (O-Z larger) AND both channels' offset
                  vs the LCDM sigma_8=0.811 reference; "~0.7% apart" is justified, NOT a runtime discovery.

  layer — downstream gates can no longer silently conflate the spectral-action and
  growth σ₈ readouts, and the headline-σ₈ designation (O-Z 0.799) is pinned. M4

FAIL_meaning: >
  At least one pin fails to resolve via get_constant, OR a PROVENANCE entry is empty,

  conflation the gate exists to close is not closed), OR the cross-note is absent.

  METHODOLOGY-class-eligible and routes to COMPUTE/MIXED triage). Solution-space
  meaning: the channel-keyed hygiene promotion did not land; the σ₈ conflation
  corridor remains open.

  Reserved for the partial-landing diagnostic: both pins resolve and are channel-tagged

  is incomplete (a flag for a follow-up cross-note refinement, not a conflation failure).
  Also the honest-closure outcome if an upstream value cannot be confirmed at dispatch
  (mechanical-closure per the prerequisites above) — emitted as INFO with the blocking
  record named, never as a fabricated PASS.

| Test | Requirement | This gate | Verdict |
|:-----|:------------|:----------|:--------|

| **M2** — Producing-operation type | `Edit`/`Write` on canonical-constants/rules/templates + integer/grep/SHA cross-checks; NO `.py` numerical-threshold script | Producing op = `update_constant` (×2) + `get_constant`-verify + grep SECTION-E diff cross-check; the optional `s98_w6_sigma8_pin_verify.py` does get_constant-resolution + grep ONLY (no eigenvalues / linear algebra / numerical threshold) | **HOLDS** |
| **M3** — Source-of-truth type | Verbatim values from a prior closed gate / pre-registered enumeration; NO first-principles new derivation | Both σ₈ values are VERBATIM from closed gates: `sigma8_OZ_50=0.799` from SIGMA8-OZ-50 (S50 PASS, atlas-07 permanent); `sigma8_growth_a2=0.79317` from `S97-FSIGMA8-FORECAST-REFETCH` (S97 PASS, audit `a20043e7`) / S70 lineage. No new physics. | **HOLDS** |
| **M4** — Allowlist membership | gate-ID in `methodology-wave-allowlist-ledger.md` | gate-ID `S98-HK-SIGMA8-CHANNEL-KEYED-PINS` **NOT YET LISTED** (grep → 0). **Requires orchestrator append at plan-freeze** (see allowlist-append FLAG above). | **PENDING → HOLDS after orchestrator append** |

**Conjunction**: `M1 ∧ M2 ∧ M3 ∧ M4` = METHODOLOGY-class, CONTINGENT on the M4 orchestrator allowlist append. Until M4 lands, the gate is M1∧M2∧M3-eligible but M4-blocked; the orchestrator MUST append the ledger row at plan-freeze to complete the conjunction. The gate carries NO numerical threshold, so the M4-fallthrough-to-COMPUTE path is structurally non-viable — this gate is METHODOLOGY-class or it does not run.

**Dispatch path**: METHODOLOGY-class waves SKIP `/rclab-coordinate` compute-mode per `wave-classification.md §"Dispatch consequences"` — the orchestrator (or the designated `gen-physicist` writer) effects the `update_constant` promotions + WP section directly, treating the gate like a team-lead synthesis section. The dual-SHA closure is `content_sha256` over the canonical_constants.py SECTION-E diff + `audit_sha256` over the input-pin map (the two upstream gate records + the naming/cross-note pin map) per `wave-classification.md §"Dual-SHA closure for METHODOLOGY-class"`.

## Wave 6 → (terminal) Decision Point

Wave 6 is terminal in the S98 fanout (canonical-constants hygiene; no downstream S98 wave consumes its outputs). Outcomes:

- **PASS** → both channel-keyed σ₈ pins are canonical with channel-distinct provenance + cross-note; the σ₈-channel-conflation corridor is closed at the canonical-constants layer; the headline-σ₈ designation (O-Z 0.799) is pinned. The `/weave --update` knowledge-index rebuild picks up the two new constants + PROVENANCE entries. No carry-forward.
- **INFO (partial)** → pins land + channel-tagged, but the headline designation or LCDM-reference disambiguation in the cross-note needs refinement → a single-line cross-note-refinement carry-forward (Q2-hygiene §A in-session fix if caught at dispatch; otherwise §B mirror) — NOT a new compute.
- **INFO (honest closure)** → an upstream σ₈ value could not be confirmed at dispatch → mechanical-closure per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md`, naming the blocking record; re-run when the upstream is confirmable. No fabricated value.
- **FAIL** → a pin failed to resolve / channels not distinctly tagged / cross-note absent / M4 row not appended → re-dispatch the promotion (the value is verbatim-upstream, so a FAIL is a write/registration defect, not a physics result); fix in-session per `feedback_fix-in-session-never-defer.md`.

Single gate; the aggregate is the `§W6-1` `machinery_pin_map` above. There is NO numerical free parameter (no `N_eval`/`L_max`/`scan_range`/`step_size`/`tolerance`/`random_seed`/`GPU_path` — all N/A, deterministic pin promotion). `D_PRU_raw = 0`: every machinery slot is pinned or declared N/A-with-reason.
